This is the original studio version of Wonderwall by Oasis, capturing how the song was actually played on the recording. Unlike our simplified arrangement, this chart keeps the exact chord voicings and capo position in the original key of F# minor. It is designed for guitarists ready to move past the basics and capture the true feel of Oasis's performance.
